patterns.note: Feature sections frequently employ a two-column layout, alternating the position of explanatory text and detailed product UI mockups to guide the user through functionality.
Headings are large, bold sans-serif, often highlighting a key word in the brand's accent green, creating a strong visual hierarchy and drawing attention to core concepts.
Subtle, multi-color gradients are used as background elements in the hero and footer sections, providing a modern, airy feel without distracting from content.

As the user scrolls, the background gradient in the hero section exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground content, while subsequent content sections fade in or slide up as they enter the viewport.
The site heavily integrates highly detailed, realistic product UI mockups directly into feature explanations, serving as primary visual aids rather than abstract illustrations.

technique_notes: The navigation bar transitions from a transparent background to a solid white background with a subtle shadow, becoming sticky at the top of the viewport after the user scrolls past the initial hero content.
Background gradients are implemented to scroll at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a gentle parallax effect that adds depth and visual interest to the page.
Content sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, typically a soft fade-in or a subtle slide-up effect, as they become visible within the user's viewport, enhancing engagement.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) with a clear hierarchy down to small, legible body and label text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., 4-8px) on buttons, cards, and UI elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, especially in the hero and between major sections, with tighter spacing within feature grids and the FAQ accordion.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its heavy reliance on highly detailed, realistic product UI mockups that are seamlessly integrated into the content, making the product's functionality immediately clear and tangible. The subtle, multi-color gradient backgrounds that shift with a gentle parallax effect also contribute to a modern and polished feel.
